condition: Execute only when RES-20260726-SMT-OVERREACTION-RECLAIM-001 has hard validity PASS and main_mss_survivor_count equal to zero.
economic_hypothesis: A completed BTC displacement can create a beta-relative SOL/XRP external-liquidity overrun. After causal CISD/MSS confirmation, some overruns are genuine exhaustion and others are only pauses before continuation. A shallow cost-sensitive model using confirmation-time state may separate these cases strongly enough to trade the frozen equilibrium-reclaim path after 24 bp.

smc_ict_translation.impulse: completed BTC displacement with aligned aggressive flow and abnormal activity
smc_ict_translation.liquidity_run: SOL/XRP extends beyond its prior-only beta fair value
smc_ict_translation.smt_divergence: positive direction-adjusted follower-minus-beta residual of at least 12 bp
smc_ict_translation.cisd_mss: residual contracts to at most 80 percent of its event value while completed trailing one-second follower aggressor flow turns opposite
smc_ict_translation.model_role: classify genuine exhaustion/reclaim versus continuation through the liquidity pool
smc_ict_translation.target: residual remains at or below 25 percent of the event value for one completed second
smc_ict_translation.invalidation: residual expands to 150 percent, follower extends another 50 percent of the event gap, or BTC loses displacement origin

data_contract.source: Bybit public BTCUSDT, SOLUSDT and XRPUSDT USDT-linear trade archives
data_contract.date_rule: fixed monthly Sunday partitions chosen before this ML outcome; no date may be substituted after access

frozen_event_contract.event_rearm: BTC displacement must remain at or below 25 percent for one completed second

models.name: sparse_logistic_control
models.definition: median imputation, standardization and L2 logistic regression with class_weight balanced and C 0.2

models.name: shallow_histogram_gradient_boosting
models.definition: median imputation and histogram gradient boosting with max_depth 3, max_iter 100, learning_rate 0.05 and l2_regularization 1.0

training_contract.label: frozen MSS trade net return positive after 24 bp
training_contract.objective: minimum of the two latency-specific winner-removed account log-growth rates, not AUC

execution_and_account_contract.winner_removal: exclude the largest ceil(10 percent) positive 24-bp event keys and reroute chronologically

forbidden: future MFE MAE or target result as model input
deep learning before shallow economic survival
changing the frozen event MSS target invalidation cost risk or leverage rules
adjacent threshold search after a zero-survivor result
retirement_rule: If the calibration-selected pair does not survive both latencies through development and fixed selection evidence, retire the complete BTC-to-alt overreaction-reclaim information unit.
